title: RevisionDebtEntry
description: Single row in the revision-debt store. Every structured advisory produced by the pipeline (CanonExpert, GateCritic, FinalGate, MetricsDashboard, PresenceChecker near-misses, compression guard, word-count telemetry, StateFirewall, SceneReviewer) writes one of these. The category enum is closed: adding a new category requires a schema bump. See docs/architecture/architecture_upgrade_spec.md §6.2.

producer.description: Which pipeline component wrote the row. One of: canon_expert, gate_critic, final_gate, quality_metrics, presence_checker, state_firewall, word_count_telemetry, compression_guard, scene_reviewer.

category.description: Closed set. Adding a new category requires a schema bump + store.CATEGORIES update.

summary.description: One-line human summary. Required for UI/CLI listing.

details.description: Structured payload specific to the producer (failure codes, metric names, fix_from/fix_to, etc.).

fix_scope.description: Suggested smallest unit of revision to address the debt.

owner_or_reviewer_notes.description: Human-only field. No agent writes to this.
